name: gmail_cbs_cleanroom
title: Mail Cleanroom Prototype
description: Empty AdaOS desktop canvas ready for Builder authoring.

llm_hints.description:
Create a new private AdaOS Application named "Gmail CBS Cleanroom" from
scratch, with technical id gmail_cbs_cleanroom. It must be CBS-compatible. Its
semantic Application requires capability:mail.messages.manage version ^1.0.0
without naming Gmail, a package, a skill, endpoints, account ids, or
credentials. For this first beta, realize that requirement with an
Application-local Gmail binding.

The user experience must include connection and setup status, inbox and label
navigation, search and unread/starred filters, message list and reading,
labels, archive, trash, read/unread, star/unstar, compose, and send. Include
responsive wide and compact layouts and deterministic loading, empty, offline,
provider-error, permission-denied, and authorization-required states. Explain
least-privilege access. OAuth secrets and tokens must never enter UI state,
manifests, fixtures, logs, errors, or telemetry. Keep shared provider reuse and
a global capability registry outside this first stage.

Build the executable Prototype now. Keep real external operations as explicit
pending Automation requirements; do not simulate successful authorization or
use live Gmail data in the Prototype.
